reviewType: Representative narrative synthesis, not an exhaustive systematic review or a reproduced leaderboard
focus: Coding Agents and Work Agents that execute verifiable tasks; chat and memory are brief background only

works.name: AgentBench
works.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
works.method: 多种交互环境中的逐步观察与行动
works.measure: 任务成功及分环境表现
works.boundary: 能力评测，不等于固定服务栈的容量测试

works.name: AgentBoard
works.title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents
works.method: 多轮环境中记录过程进展
works.measure: 进展率与成功率等分析指标
works.boundary: 过程推进不自动等于端到端低延迟

works.name: GAIA
works.title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
works.method: 需搜索、工具或多模态处理的真实问题
works.measure: 最终答案正确性
works.boundary: 路径由Agent实现决定，不固定推理请求序列

works.name: ToolBench / ToolLLM
works.title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
works.method: 真实API指令、工具链与自动评判
works.measure: 工具任务完成与解法质量
works.boundary: 线上API变化会影响稳定性

works.name: StableToolBench
works.title: StableToolBench: Towards Stable Large-Scale Benchmarking on Tool Learning of Large Language Models
works.method: 虚拟API服务器结合缓存、模拟器和稳定评判
works.measure: 较稳定的工具功能比较
works.boundary: 模拟工具延迟不能代替真实工具性能

works.name: BFCL
works.title: The Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL): From Tool Use to Agentic Evaluation of Large Language Models
works.method: 单轮AST/执行校验与多轮有状态评测分开
works.measure: 调用正确性、状态及交互完成
works.boundary: 必须注明版本与子集，不能混同单轮和多轮分数

works.name: τ-bench
works.title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
works.method: Agent与模拟用户交互并调用领域数据库API
works.measure: 目标数据库状态、重复运行一致性pass^k
works.boundary: 模拟用户也是实验变量，需冻结其配置

works.name: τ²-bench
works.title: τ²-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
works.method: 用户与Agent都能操作共享环境
works.measure: 沟通、协调与任务完成
works.boundary: 不是仅增加对话轮数，环境控制权限也变化

works.name: WebArena
works.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
works.method: 可复现网站中执行长路径网页任务
works.measure: 功能性任务完成
works.boundary: 网页交互成本不能由模型token吞吐表示

works.name: VisualWebArena
works.title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
works.method: 需要视觉理解与网页动作的多模态任务
works.measure: 视觉落地后的任务成功
works.boundary: 文本token之外还须说明图像输入和处理开销

works.name: OSWorld
works.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
works.method: 真实桌面环境、初始状态与执行式校验
works.measure: 跨应用操作及最终环境状态
works.boundary: 环境重置、GUI及文件状态属于协议的一部分

works.name: SWE-bench
works.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
works.method: 根据仓库问题生成修复并通过测试验收
works.measure: 问题是否解决
works.boundary: 不是按补丁文本相似度或自报完成打分

works.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
works.title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
works.method: 独立终端环境中执行真实任务并运行验证测试
works.measure: 终态产物及测试是否通过
works.boundary: 此处明确为2.0论文，不混用不同代任务集合

works.name: MLE-bench
works.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
works.method: 执行数据准备、训练和实验等机器学习工程任务
works.measure: 竞赛任务的最终表现
works.boundary: Agent用的模型与其训练程序消耗的资源须区分

works.name: LongMemEval
works.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
works.method: 跨会话历史中的提取、时序、更新及拒答问题
works.measure: 长期交互记忆正确性
works.boundary: 是记忆能力评测，不是KV缓存命中测试

works.name: LoCoMo
works.title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
works.method: 长时多会话对话上的问答、总结与多模态评估
works.measure: 长程信息与事件关联保持
works.boundary: 会话多不等于已执行真实工具工作流

works.name: AgentDojo
works.title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
works.method: 不可信工具返回中注入攻击并比较防护
works.measure: 攻击成功与正常任务可用性
works.boundary: 不应只看攻击阻断率而忽略任务是否还能完成

works.name: Terminal-Bench难度有效性研究
works.title: What Makes a Terminal-Bench Task Hard? Separating Genuine Hardness from Fake-Hardness on an Adjudicated Agentic Corpus
works.authors: Edward Lue Chee Lip and others
works.method: 结合参考解、基础设施、绕过与审阅记录检查全失败题
works.measure: 未解决结论的证据有效性
works.boundary: 指定语料的诊断，不代表所有Terminal-Bench版本均有同样问题

works.name: MultiAgentBench
works.title: MultiAgentBench: Evaluating the Collaboration and Competition of LLM agents
works.method: 交互场景下改变协作拓扑和协调策略
works.measure: 完成度与里程碑式协作/竞争表现
works.boundary: 多个答题客户端并行不等于协作型多Agent实验

works.name: ReAct
works.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
works.method: 交替推理、行动和环境观察的执行策略
works.measure: 在对应任务中评估决策效果
works.boundary: 是执行方法，不是独立统一评测标准

works.name: AgentX Harness
works.title: AgentX Harness
works.method: 按轨迹长度和前缀共享结构回放模型请求
works.measure: 推理延迟、吞吐及缓存行为
works.boundary: 不自动恢复工具语义、真实等待或任务质量

works.name: PagedAttention
works.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
works.method: 分页式KV块管理及共享
works.measure: 显存管理效率与推理吞吐
works.boundary: 缓存管理机制，不是完整Agent任务基准

works.name: SGLang
works.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
works.method: 结构化程序前端与RadixAttention前缀复用运行时
works.measure: 多调用程序的执行效率
works.boundary: 前缀复用不等于跨会话事实记忆正确性

works.name: Parrot
works.title: Parrot: Efficient Serving of LLM-based Applications with Semantic Variable
works.method: Semantic Variable暴露请求之间的数据流依赖
works.measure: 应用端到端服务表现
works.boundary: 需要应用信息，不等价于只调单请求batch大小

works.name: InferCept
works.title: InferCept: Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
works.method: 围绕外部交互暂停选择保留、换出或重算上下文
works.measure: 状态占用与恢复/服务效率权衡
works.boundary: 策略收益依赖等待时长、链路和资源条件

works.name: AgentSight
works.title: AgentSight: System-Level Observability for AI Agents Using eBPF
works.method: 在边界关联LLM通信与eBPF内核事件
works.measure: 跨进程语义—动作观测与诊断
works.boundary: 观测工具不是任务正确性的验收器

works.name: AgentSysBench
works.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems
works.method: 统一工作负载/服务栈说明与多组件测量，并补充生产轨迹
works.measure: 端到端耗时、状态、资源与控制面行为
works.boundary: 受控执行与生产观察回答互补问题，不互相替代

works.name: SWE-agent
works.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
works.method: 专用Agent-Computer Interface连接仓库、编辑与测试
works.measure: 交互接口对软件任务解题的影响
works.boundary: 执行框架是变量，不是换模型就自动保持等价

works.name: SWE-bench Pro
works.title: SWE-Bench Pro: Can AI Agents Solve Long-Horizon Software Engineering Tasks?
works.method: 企业仓库上的长时、多文件任务与人工核验
works.measure: 复杂软件问题解决能力
works.boundary: 公开、保留与商业集合不能混排

works.name: SWE-bench-Live
works.title: SWE-bench Goes Live!
works.method: 持续更新问题及专用Docker环境的构建流水线
works.measure: 更新、更广仓库上的可执行修复
works.boundary: 实时更新仍需冻结评测快照，不能宣称绝无污染

works.name: Agentless
works.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
works.method: 定位、修复、补丁验证的固定三阶段流程
works.measure: 简单流程与自主Agent的能力/成本对照
works.boundary: 不是工具自主循环，适合作为受控基线

works.name: OpenHands
works.title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
works.method: 沙盒内统一代码、命令行、网页与Agent扩展
works.measure: 通用开发Agent实现与多类任务评价
works.boundary: 是执行平台，不是单一固定难度的题库

works.name: WorkArena
works.title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
works.method: ServiceNow企业应用任务与BrowserGym交互环境
works.measure: 知识工作中的业务操作完成
works.boundary: 需控制网页状态、业务记录与观察/动作接口

works.name: WorkArena++
works.title: WorkArena++: Towards Compositional Planning and Reasoning-based Common Knowledge Work Tasks
works.method: 组合检索、推理和操作步骤构成企业工作流
works.measure: 组合规划与多步骤知识工作
works.boundary: 难度不仅来自上下文长，还来自步骤依赖

works.name: TheAgentCompany
works.title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks
works.method: 模拟公司内跨网站、代码、程序与同事通信
works.measure: 数字员工能否交付真实工作任务
works.boundary: 需要跨应用终态，不能只看某次工具调用成功

works.name: AssistantBench
works.title: AssistantBench: Can Web Agents Solve Realistic and Time-Consuming Tasks?
works.method: 开放网页上的现实、耗时信息搜集任务
works.measure: 最终信息是否正确，导航是否有效
works.boundary: 公开网页会变化，需记录检索时间和证据

works.name: SpreadsheetBench
works.title: SpreadsheetBench: Towards Challenging Real World Spreadsheet Manipulation
works.method: 真实Excel需求及多份变化输入文件校验
works.measure: 表格修改在变化数据下是否仍正确
works.boundary: 文件可打开或单个样例正确不够

works.name: BrowseComp
works.title: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents
works.method: 持续浏览寻找难查信息，最终答案简短可校验
works.measure: 信息搜集的持久性和检索能力
works.boundary: 不等价于完整企业工作流和长报告交付

works.name: CRMArena-Pro
works.title: CRMArena-Pro: Holistic Assessment of LLM Agents Across Diverse Business Scenarios and Interactions
works.method: 销售、服务与报价业务，加入交互和保密评估
works.measure: 业务完成、交互与保密要求
works.boundary: 真实业务对话不应简化为普通聊天评分

works.name: ScienceAgentBench
works.title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
works.method: 从科研工作流抽取任务，验证Python程序与运行结果
works.measure: 特定科研步骤的正确性与执行成本
works.boundary: 子任务通过不等于已经自动完成整篇科研

works.name: PaperBench
works.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
works.method: 从论文复现到代码和实验，用分层rubric与评判器评分
works.measure: 分解后的研究复现完成度
works.boundary: 分项得分不是整篇复现通过率，评判器也需验证

works.name: SpreadsheetBench 2
works.title: SpreadsheetBench 2: Evaluating Agents on End-to-End Business Spreadsheet Workflows
works.method: 跨工作表的生成、调试和可视化业务流程
works.measure: 端到端电子表格产物的准确性
works.boundary: 不能把不同版本和任务集合的分数直接相减

works.name: OpenHands-Versa
works.title: Coding Agents with Multimodal Browsing are Generalist Problem Solvers
works.method: 用编辑执行、搜索、视觉浏览和文件访问连接Coding与Work
works.measure: 跨软件和办公任务的通用性
works.boundary: 不是多放几种工具就已证明全领域通用
